principles: Map only semantics supported by the legacy record itself.
Preserve ambiguous or stale values as observations rather than upgrading them.
Never consult current overlays to enrich a historical-baseline rehearsal.
Never write migration output into canonical registry paths during rehearsal.

aliases.rationale: Legacy aliases are useful provenance but are not a v2 PROCUREMENT root field.

argus_id.rationale: Permanent ARGUS identity must not change during schema migration.

canonical_name_or_title.rationale: Legacy canonical title maps directly to the v2 normalized title.

created_at.rationale: Legacy record creation timestamp is provenance metadata, not procurement lifecycle time.

evidence_refs.rationale: Legacy evidence entries become field-level provenance without evidence-state upgrading.

external_refs.rationale: Legacy external references have heterogeneous semantics and require typed resolution before becoming v2 identifiers.

information_classification.rationale: Legacy information-classification metadata is preserved but is outside the v2 procurement payload.

record_type.rationale: The transformer accepts PROCUREMENT records only; v2 payload type is defined by the schema context.

related_argus_ids.rationale: Legacy canonical links become explicit v2 related-record references.

relationships.rationale: Preserve relationship targets and relation types without copying linked-record attributes.

revision.rationale: Preserve the source canonical-record revision as the rehearsal payload revision.

schema_version.rationale: Legacy registry schema version remains migration provenance.

status.rationale: Legacy record status is data-governance state and must not be treated as current procurement-process truth.

updated_at.rationale: Legacy record update timestamp is provenance metadata, not a procurement event.

attributes.buyer_entity_id.rationale: The legacy field explicitly identifies the buyer party.

attributes.currency.rationale: A standalone currency without a value/scope cannot safely become process currency.

attributes.funding_source_raw.rationale: Raw funding wording must be semantically resolved before creating budget or financing structures.

attributes.material_unknowns.rationale: Explicit unresolved decision-relevant facts retain their meaning in v2 intelligence.

attributes.official_reference.rationale: Legacy generic official_reference is semantically unsafe; WD-2 is known not to be the PE tender reference in the current reconciliation.

attributes.package_reference.rationale: Legacy generic package_reference is semantically unsafe; WD-2 must not be typed as PACKAGE_NO without source resolution.

attributes.procurement_method.rationale: Preserve the exact legacy method code without inferring normalized method or market scope.

attributes.procurement_state.rationale: Preserve the legacy process-state text as raw status only.

attributes.procurement_type.rationale: Legacy descriptive procurement type cannot safely determine GOODS/WORKS or competition scope.

attributes.procuring_entity_id.rationale: The legacy field explicitly identifies the procuring entity party.

attributes.project_id.rationale: Project linkage becomes a canonical related-record reference.

attributes.quantity.rationale: Legacy procurement-level quantity/unit can be preserved as one generic item when both remain attached to the procurement title.
